{"stdout":"0.06 21.9
- Capacity (pre-purchased) storage about $23/TB-month, US AWS [S1]; also 'about $23/TB' [S2] (keebo.ai, https://keebo.ai/blog/snowflake-pricing, 'Guide for 2026', retrieved 22 Oct 2026; snippet only). Both secondary sources agree; I did not verify against Snowflake's own pricing page. Use $23 as the base, $40 as the on-demand upper bound.
- Compression ratios 3x / 5x / 8x are **assumptions** (no Snowflake-documented figure was retrieved in this step); real ratio depends on the event schema, JSON in VARIANT versus typed columns, and must be measured on one week of real data (see SYSTEM$ / TABLE_STORAGE_METRICS).
- Time Travel 1 day and Fail-safe 7 days are Snowflake's standard retention model [unverified]; Fail-safe is not configurable and applies to permanent tables; Time Travel/Fail-safe hold only changed or deleted micro-partitions, so append-only raw data adds little. Churn model is an assumption.
- Dedup copy assumed the same size as raw (duplicates are expected to be a few %, assumption).

## Scenario table

| Scenario | TB stored | Arithmetic | Monthly USD @ $23 (capacity) | Monthly USD @ $40 (on-demand) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A. Raw, uncompressed (headline) | 21.90 | 0.060 TB/day x 365 = 21.9 TB | $504 | $876 |
| B3. Raw, 3x compression | 7.30 | 21.9/3 | $168 | $292 |
| B5. Raw, 5x compression | 4.38 | 21.9/5 | $101 | $175 |
| B8. Raw, 8x compression | 2.74 | 21.9/8 | $63 | $110 |
| C. Raw + deduped copy, 5x | 8.76 | 2 x 4.38 | $201 | $350 |
| D. C + Time Travel 1 day + Fail-safe 7 days (append-mostly, 5x) | 8.95 | 2x4.38 + 2 copies x (1d x 0.012 + 7d x 0.012) = 8.952 | $206 | $358 |
| E. Stress: raw + dedup, 3x, 1 day full-day churn kept for TT 1d + FS 7d | 14.92 | 2x7.30 + 2 x 8 x 0.020 | $343 | $597 |
| F. Raw uncompressed + dedup copy uncompressed (no compression credit) | 43.80 | 2 x 21.9 | $1,007 | $1,752 |

Monthly USD = TB x price per TB-month ($23 [S1][S2], $40 [S1]); this is the cost at year end, when the full 365 days are held. Average over the year is about half (linear growth).

## Reading the table

- Realistic planning case is D: about 9.0 TB, about $206/month at $23 and $358 at $40. Storage is a small cost next to warehouse compute.
- Even the no-compression ceiling (A, 21.9 TB) is only about $504/month at $23 [S1][S2].
- Levers: make RAW.CLICK_EVENTS retention-limited (e.g. 30-90 days, then keep CLEAN only); use a transient table for staging with DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS=0 (no Fail-safe); keep Time Travel at 1 day.

Prepared 22 Oct 2026 (America/Chicago).

## Headline

30,000,000 events/day x 2,000 B = 60 GB/day (calc: 30e6*2000/1e9 = 60). 60 GB x 365 = 21.9 TB (calc: 60*365/1000 = 21.9). **Headline: 21.9 TB, about 22 TB uncompressed** (decimal TB, 1 TB = 1000 GB).

## Prices and sources

- On-demand storage about $40/TB-month, US region on AWS [S1] (espresso.ai, https://espresso.ai/post/explaining-snowflake-pricing; search snippet only, page date not shown, retrieved 22 Oct 2026).
- Capacity (pre-purchased) storage about $23/TB-month, US AWS [S1]; also 'about $23/TB' [S2] (keebo.ai, https://keebo.ai/blog/snowflake-pricing, 'Guide for 2026', retrieved 22 Oct 2026; snippet only). Both secondary sources agree; I did not verify against Snowflake's own pricing page. Use $23 as the base, $40 as the on-demand upper bound.
- Compression ratios 3x / 5x / 8x are **assumptions** (no Snowflake-documented figure was retrieved in this step); real ratio depends on the event schema, JSON in VARIANT versus typed columns, and must be measured on one week of real data (see SYSTEM$ / TABLE_STORAGE_METRICS).
- Time Travel 1 day and Fail-safe 7 days are Snowflake's standard retention model [unverified]; Fail-safe is not configurable and applies to permanent tables; Time Travel/Fail-safe hold only changed or deleted micro-partitions, so append-only raw data adds little. Churn model is an assumption.
- Dedup copy assumed the same size as raw (duplicates are expected to be a few %, assumption).

## Scenario table

| Scenario | TB stored | Arithmetic | Monthly USD @ $23 (capacity) | Monthly USD @ $40 (on-demand) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A. Raw, uncompressed (headline) | 21.90 | 0.060 TB/day x 365 = 21.9 TB | $504 | $876 |
| B3. Raw, 3x compression | 7.30 | 21.9/3 | $168 | $292 |
| B5. Raw, 5x compression | 4.38 | 21.9/5 | $101 | $175 |
| B8. Raw, 8x compression | 2.74 | 21.9/8 | $63 | $110 |
| C. Raw + deduped copy, 5x | 8.76 | 2 x 4.38 | $201 | $350 |
| D. C + Time Travel 1 day + Fail-safe 7 days (append-mostly, 5x) | 8.95 | 2x4.38 + 2 copies x (1d x 0.012 + 7d x 0.012) = 8.952 | $206 | $358 |
| E. Stress: raw + dedup, 3x, 1 day full-day churn kept for TT 1d + FS 7d | 14.92 | 2x7.30 + 2 x 8 x 0.020 | $343 | $597 |
| F. Raw uncompressed + dedup copy uncompressed (no compression credit) | 43.80 | 2 x 21.9 | $1,007 | $1,752 |

Monthly USD = TB x price per TB-month ($23 [S1][S2], $40 [S1]); this is the cost at year end, when the full 365 days are held. Average over the year is about half (linear growth).

## Reading the table

- Realistic planning case is D: about 9.0 TB, about $206/month at $23 and $358 at $40. Storage is a small cost next to warehouse compute.
- Even the no-compression ceiling (A, 21.9 TB) is only about $504/month at $23 [S1][S2].
- Levers: make RAW.CLICK_EVENTS retention-limited (e.g. 30-90 days, then keep CLEAN only); use a transient table for staging with DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS=0 (no Fail-safe); keep Time Travel at 1 day.
- Not included: compute, Snowpipe Streaming ingest fees, cloud-services, data transfer, and the MART tables (tiny: countries x days).
